description.value: Scott's Inn & Suites is a long-established downtown Kamloops hotel that has operated for over 60 years, offering studio to three-bedroom suites with kitchenettes and amenities including a rooftop sundeck with BBQ and free parking. On-site food is now provided by 'Scott's On The Go Eats,' a grab-and-go counter offering fresh snacks, coffee, cold beverages, and ice cream after the original restaurant closed due to fire. Its central location and ample parking make it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists passing through Kamloops.

No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; Wi-Fi is confirmed hotel-wide via the amenities page.
